description: An offset that a button or a trigger steps up and down, added to whatever is patched through, in 2HP

params.text: Sets how much each step moves the offset, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise
Attenuates and inverts the step-size CV between -100% and +100%, and comes up at 0%
Adds one step to the offset
Takes one step off the offset

inputs.text: Adds its voltage to the step size after the trim; a polyphonic signal here gives each channel its own step
A rising edge adds one step to the offset
A rising edge takes one step off the offset
A rising edge sets the offset back to 0V
The signal the offset is added to

outputs.text: Carries the input with the accumulated offset added

notes: the offset is kept per channel and survives until a reset, so the module counts as long as you keep sending steps
an increment and a decrement arriving in the same cycle cancel out, and a reset in the same cycle as either of them wins
the offset keeps climbing past the clipping range, so for long runs either turn the clipping off and clamp the result elsewhere, or wrap it with a Fold
menu: Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Trigger-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming trigger counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Trigger-low detect-level — sets the voltage an incoming trigger must fall back below before the next one is counted, under 0.1V unless you change it

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
